thread:
sophia: FYI vault-audit alerted about a spike of failed KMS unwraps for svc-prod-data yesterday evening. seems like someone replayed ciphertexts in our partner logs :rotating_light:
sec-bot: [alert] 2026-03-20T19:02Z - vault: failed_transit_unwrap count=312 svcaccount=svc-prod-data region=us-west1
raj: ugh. can someone confirm if it's actual key compromise or just malformed ciphertexts from partner ingest?
sanjay: i'm running a quick scan on the logging bucket now. command i'm using: `gsutil ls gs://redwood-partner-logs/2026-03-20/** | xargs -n1 gsutil cat | grep -E "(ciphertext|transit:wrapped)"`
jess: if it is real we should do a scoped rotation and short-lived deny on the service account. can we throttle the partner endpoint while we triage?
oncall-ops: i can flip a temporary 503 on the partner-ingest route for up to 30m. want me to do that now?
sophia: yes please hold traffic. @oncall-ops proceed. raj + sanjay, collect sample ciphertext blobs and paste to the incident channel (redact any PII).
sanjay: samples posted to #incidents thread. initial grep shows a repeated pattern that looks like valid transit ciphertext but with an older KMS key id (key: projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/tr-prod/cryptoKeys/key-v1).
maria: that suggests someone replayed archived blobs wrapped with the old key. if the old key was rotated/deprecated we need to know if unwrapping still works anywhere. check KMS IAM bindings.
jess: recommend workflow: 1) deny svc-prod-data on vault transit for default key 2) create new key (key-v2) + rewrap procedure, 3) issue new short-lived tokens to downstream services, 4) rotate wrapper and revoke leases. who owns each step?
raj: i'll handle KMS bindings and create key-v2. timeline ~30m.
sophia: assign rotations: raj = create key & rewrap plan, sanjay = validate which blobs cannot be unwrapped with key-v2 (report), jess = coordinate token reissue and terraform change, maria = audit/logging retention + forwarder checks. i'll own overall coordination and postmortem.
oncall-ops: traffic held. turning on 503 now.
sec-bot: ticket created: SEC-2026-084 - vault-kms-ciphertext-replay. assignees: raj,sanjay,jess,maria. priority: P1.
sophia: quick safety steps (do now):
- revoke all active Vault wrap/unwrap roles for svc-prod-data: `vault policy write deny-wrap - <<EOF
path "transit/*" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF`
- rotate any long-lived service tokens that svc-prod-data uses
- snapshot current KMS key state and ACLs (raj)
- preserve evidence: copy implicated blobs to secure bucket with access log enabled

sanjay: running `gsutil cp -r gs://redwood-partner-logs/2026-03-20/implicated/ gs://redwood-secure-evidence/SEC-2026-084/` now. will also checksum each file.
raj: created key-v2: `gcloud kms keys create key-v2 --location global --keyring tr-prod --purpose encryption` and started rewrap plan. note: we cannot rewrap without having plaintext, so for blobs we can't unwrap we need to treat as potentially exfiltrated.
jess: on token side: i have a script to issue ephemeral creds via workload identity federation, will rotate creds and update deploys via canary. patch in and hold canary at 10% until we get green.
maria: audit changes: need to extend vault audit retention for this tenant to 180 days and export KMS audit logs to sec-analytics project. i'll open the infra PR. also let's enable more verbose unwrap logs (non-PII) for 72h.
sophia: good. expected quick wins: stop traffic, create new key, revoke immediate privileges, rotate tokens. medium term: rewrap/redeploy and then forensic analysis. long term: add automated detection for old-key unwrap attempts and an on-call runbook.
raj: question on RBAC: do we want to temporarily remove `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from svc-prod-data or add an explicit deny? removing role may break other apps. i'd prefer adding an organization-level conditional deny for that key only.
jess: agree, do conditional deny scoped to the old key id and only for vault's SA. less blast radius.
sophia: do the conditional deny; have rollback plan: remove deny and re-add old role if we see unexpected failures. document in ticket.
oncall-ops: traffic unblocked for 5m window for smoke tests. monitoring on.
sanjay: report: of 312 failed unwraps, ~280 were using key-v1 id; 32 are malformed. copying full report to SEC-2026-084 ticket.
sec-bot: update SEC-2026-084 status -> triage_in_progress.
sophia: next actions and owners pinned in ticket. target containment complete in 3 hours. postmortem owner: sophia. everyone, add any follow-ups to the ticket. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
